entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse. Order number is VF-886-015.

Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order number... VF-886-015. Got it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's neither. I just need to return it. I tried to do this online over a week ago but your site was broken. Can you just send me the label?
I understand you're looking for a quick resolution. You mentioned a website error when you first tried? Can you tell me more about that?
Yes, I tried on the 24th of December. The whole return portal was down. I have a screenshot of the error page. I couldn't print a label or even start the process because your system was down.

Thank you for that information, I appreciate you clarifying. Let me check our system logs for that date. ... Yes, I do see a service bulletin about a known outage on the 24th that affected our returns portal. I'm sorry you ran into that.

Let me just check the policy here for your item... Okay, I see your order was delivered 18 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can process this for you right now.
Great. Just email me the label.

Absolutely. I've just generated the return authorization and sent the prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
